title: PPE Guide
disclaimer: PPE is the last line of the hierarchy of controls. Standards shown are common references (EN, ANSI, IS); your site, client or country may require others. Always check the safety data sheet and the maker's instructions.

ppe_items.name: Safety helmet
pre_use_checks: No cracks, dents or chalky/faded shell (UV damage)
Suspension and harness intact, correct size
Chin strap works when working at height
Within the maker's service life; replace after any heavy impact

ppe_items.name: Safety glasses / goggles
pre_use_checks: Lenses not scratched, cracked or cloudy
Side shields and frame intact
Marked with the standard (EN 166 or Z87.1)
Goggles seal fully against the face for splash or dust

ppe_items.name: Face shield
pre_use_checks: Visor is clear, not cracked or pitted
Headband fits and locks
Worn over safety glasses, never alone

ppe_items.name: Welding helmet / filter
pre_use_checks: Correct filter shade for the process and amperage
Auto-darkening lens works when tested
Cover plate clean and unbroken

ppe_items.name: Ear plugs / ear muffs
protects_against: Noise above the action level of 85 dB(A)
pre_use_checks: Plugs clean and soft, muffs' cushions not split
Headband keeps tension
Fitted correctly; attenuation suits the noise level

ppe_items.name: Disposable respirator (FFP / N95)
pre_use_checks: Seal check: no air leaks around the edges
Straps elastic and intact; not damp or dirty
Fit-tested for the wearer; no beard under the seal
Single shift or as the maker states

ppe_items.name: Half / full-face respirator with filters
standards: EN 14387 (gas filters: A, B, E, K, P)
protects_against: Particulates (filter type must match the hazard)
pre_use_checks: Right filter type and class for the contaminant
Filter in date, not clogged; valves clean and seat well
Fit test and seal check done
Not used in oxygen-deficient or unknown atmospheres (use supplied air or SCBA)

ppe_items.name: Mechanical gloves
pre_use_checks: No holes, thin patches or exposed stitching
Right size and grip
Cut level on the label matches the task

ppe_items.name: Chemical-resistant gloves
pre_use_checks: Material suits the exact chemical (SDS section 8)
Inflate or inspect for pinholes
Cuffs long enough; replace when swollen or tacky

ppe_items.name: Heat-resistant gloves
pre_use_checks: No burn marks, thin spots or damp lining
Rated for the contact temperature

ppe_items.name: Electrical insulating gloves
pre_use_checks: Air-inflation test for pin holes before every use
Test date in date and voltage class suits the work
Worn with leather protectors; never used if cut or contaminated

ppe_items.name: Safety footwear
pre_use_checks: Toe cap intact, sole not worn smooth
No cuts or loose sole
Class marking matches the hazard (S3 for wet, nails and oil)

ppe_items.name: High-visibility clothing
protects_against: Not being seen near vehicles and plant
pre_use_checks: Clean, bright fluorescent colour and reflective tape
Not torn or faded
Fastened and sized to be worn over other clothing

ppe_items.name: Flame-retardant / welding clothing
pre_use_checks: No burn holes, oil or grease contamination
Cotton or FR fabric, never synthetic that melts
Fully fastened; cuffs and collar closed

ppe_items.name: Arc-flash suit and hood
pre_use_checks: Rated to the incident energy in the arc-flash label
Hood visor clean and not cracked
No holes or contamination

ppe_items.name: Chemical protective suit
pre_use_checks: Suit type matches the hazard
Seams and zips not split
Used once; disposed of as chemical waste

ppe_items.name: Full-body harness
pre_use_checks: Webbing has no cuts, fraying, burns or chemical damage
Stitching intact; no pulled threads
Buckles and D-rings undamaged and working
Label readable; within the maker's date
Shock-pack or load indicator not deployed

ppe_items.name: Lanyard with energy absorber
pre_use_checks: Rope or webbing undamaged
Energy absorber pack intact, not deployed
Snap hooks lock fully and gates close
Length suits the fall clearance

ppe_items.name: Anchor point / lifeline
pre_use_checks: Rated for the load by a competent person (verify the rating)
Not bent or corroded; tagged and in inspection date
Positioned to limit swing and free-fall distance

activities.label: Welding / hot work

ppe.note: Use a welding-rated respirator when ventilation is not enough

activities.notes: Remove combustibles and keep an extinguisher at hand. Provide local exhaust ventilation.

activities.label: Grinding / cutting
permits: Hot work permit when near combustibles
activities.notes: Check the wheel rating matches the machine speed and the guard is fitted.

activities.label: Work at height

ppe.note: Use a helmet with a chin strap

activities.notes: Use collective protection (guardrails) first. A harness is a last resort. Plan rescue before work starts.

activities.label: Confined space entry

ppe.note: With a rescue line attached outside
Or supplied air / SCBA as set by the gas test

activities.notes: Never enter on a filtering mask in an unknown atmosphere. A trained standby and a rescue plan are required.

activities.label: Chemical handling
permits: Chemical-specific procedure; permit if bulk transfer
activities.notes: Read the safety data sheet section 8 for the exact PPE. Eyewash and shower must be within reach.

activities.label: Electrical work
activities.notes: Isolate and prove dead before work. Live work only when authorised and risk-assessed.

activities.label: Manual handling / warehouse
activities.notes: Mechanical aids first; team lift heavy loads. Segregate pedestrians from forklifts.

activities.label: Forklift / material handling vehicles

ppe.note: Where the site rule or overhead hazard requires

activities.notes: Use the seat belt. Check the truck before use (brakes, horn, forks, mast, tyres).

activities.label: Machine operation (rotating / cutting)

ppe.note: Not on rotating machines where gloves can be caught

activities.notes: No loose clothing, jewellery or long hair. Never wear gloves near in-running nip points.

activities.label: Painting / spray work

ppe.note: Organic-vapour filters (type A) with a particle filter

activities.notes: Remove ignition sources and ventilate. Fit-test the respirator.

activities.label: Lifting and rigging
activities.notes: Never stand under a suspended load. Inspect slings and shackles before each use.

activities.label: General factory floor
activities.notes: Follow the area signage. Housekeeping is the first line of defence.

activities.label: High-noise areas (over 85 dB(A))
activities.notes: Hearing protection is needed above the action level; reduce noise at the source first and check audiometry.

inspection_general: Check PPE before every use and replace damaged items at once.
Store PPE clean and dry, away from sunlight, heat and chemicals.
Keep inspection records for harnesses, lanyards, insulating gloves and respirators.
Train workers to fit, use, clean and store each item.
sources: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Subpart I (verify current text)
